problemBoundary: buildable machine-first flowkit CLI/host surface over existing Core; closed status/next/doctor commands plus pure checkpoint authorization evaluation; no self-hosting, Skill execution, Archify materialization or Git mutation
durableFacts: The public CLI name is flowkit and repository guidance already reserves status, next and doctor for the first stable lifecycle CLI.
A real CLI requires a production emit/build/bin contract because the current TypeScript project is noEmit and direct Node source execution cannot resolve emitted .js imports.
Existing canonical Run history plus RunContextRecord.lifecycleState can provide CurrentAction/terminal facts at STOP boundaries without a second durable CurrentAction mirror.
Policy remains the only lifecycle legality calculator; CLI must call it rather than duplicate its transition table.
OpenSpec formal observation remains read-only and is consumed through the existing thin integration.
Existing OwnerAuthorityFact is sufficient for an exact checkpoint authorization evaluator after Policy reports ready-checkpoint-evaluation.
Checkpoint authorization is distinct from Git execution; this Change does not add git add/commit/push/merge/tag.
Archify remains a Delivery-level/long-term derived projection; this CLI Change only needs its exact managed runtime identity for doctor diagnostics, not architecture materialization.
.agents Skills remain bootstrap development tools and are not a product runtime dependency.
proposalDirection: Add a minimal production build config and package bin entrypoint for flowkit without adding a runtime framework.
Expose exactly status, next and doctor as the Foundation V1 CLI command family with deterministic machine-readable output.
Keep Delivery/Change structural context explicit and compose existing durable Run, Policy, managed-tool and OpenSpec observation seams.
Add one pure checkpoint authorization evaluator outside Policy that requires ready-checkpoint-evaluation plus exact authorize-checkpoint Owner authority.
Keep doctor limited to environment/runtime diagnostics; it may resolve OpenSpec and Archify exact identities but must not render architecture.
explicitNonGoals: automatic Author/Reviewer loop or automatic next Action
new durable CurrentAction or current Delivery registry
Delivery-group YAML parser or automatic Delivery discovery
OpenSpec mutation commands or generic executor
Archify rendering/materialization or Archify as truth
Delivery Full Test execution or Owner promotion

checks.activeChangeStatus: 0/4 formal planning artifacts; proposal ready; specs/design/tasks blocked

limitations: Current Delivery 01 external-orchestrator Run payloads are bootstrap handoff records; this Explore does not claim the candidate CLI can self-manage Delivery 01.
Exact CLI flag/input schema and human-vs-JSON presentation remain Proposal/design decisions, but Delivery/Change context must remain explicit in V1.
Actual Git checkpoint execution remains an external host action after authorization; only the authorization seam belongs here.
Archify Delivery Final actual/compare materialization and long-term reference refresh remain Delivery-level operations outside this Change.
Whole-manager Windows/Linux acceptance and exact Full Test command freeze remain the final planned Change.
